answer: Set the falcon loose at random. Publish each agent's reputation as a pearl commitment - a hash of its claims - and let a ripple of beacon-seeded auditors stoop on unpredictable epochs to open and verify it. A broken commitment slashes the staked credit of the whole invitation cluster, not one account. A sybil farmer must then keep every fake account truthful on any day the falcon might strike, which costs as much as behaving honestly.
